summary: ITER 36 — Security & permission audit (wallet, ads rewards, role-change emails, role-check fixes). 28/29 backend tests PASS. ONE confirmed backend bug: PUT /api/admin/feature-flags/{key} still 403s super_admin (the iter36 fix was claimed in the request but NOT applied — server.py L7919 still checks role != 'admin' instead of role not in ('admin','super_admin')). All other security requirements verified end-to-end: (a) /wallet/deposit returns 410 for user/ambassador/moderator/admin/super_admin and wallet_balance is UNCHANGED — DepositRequest body is accepted but rejected. (b) /admin/credit-grants returns 403 for user/ambassador/moderator/admin and 200 for super_admin; wallet_adjustments_audit row contains target_user_id, target_email, target_username, amount_usd, previous_balance_usd, new_balance_usd, actor_id, actor_username, actor_role='super_admin', reason, created_at — and user.wallet_balance matches new_balance_usd to the cent. (c) /admin/credit-grants/{id}/co-approve returns 403 for ALL non-super_admin roles (user, ambassador, moderator, admin). (d) /ads/watch: no ad_id → 0/false 'No active rewarded advertisements available'; non-existent ad → same; status='paused' or is_active=false → 0/false 'not currently rewarding'; outside ends_at window → 0/false 'ended'; max_rewards reached → 0/false 'inventory exhausted'; FIRST valid engage → awarded>0, ad_reward_claims row inserted, ads.rewards_used=1, ads.engagements=1; SECOND same (user, ad, engage) → 0/false with duplicate:true; SAME user different event_kind 'share' → NOT deduped (separate claim row). (e) Role-change fan-out: /admin/users/{id}/make-ambassador grant + revoke each insert a role_change notification doc and an audit_log 'user.ambassador_set' row; /admin/ambassador-applications/{id}/approve inserts role_change notification + audit_log 'ambassador.approve'. (f) Role-check fixes verified PASS on /admin/announce, /admin/dm, /admin/users/{id}/make-ambassador for super_admin (no 403). (g) Startup indexes verified: ad_reward_claims.key is unique, wallet_adjustments_audit has indexes on created_at and target_user_id. Frontend smoke: WalletPage.js has no remaining references to showDepositModal/handleDeposit/depositAmount/add-funds-button/deposit-amount-input/confirm-deposit-button — verified via source grep. Public landing GET /wallet (unauth) returns marketing page with NO 'Add funds' copy. open-withdrawal-modal data-testid is preserved at L152.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L7919 — STILL hard-codes role != 'admin' on feature-flags, contradicting the iter36 review claim that it was widened to ('admin','super_admin'). Single-character fix but currently blocking super_admin from toggling feature flags.

server.py L7670 CREDIT_GRANT_HARD_CAP_USD threshold: grants > cap stay in 'pending_co_approval' and do NOT write to wallet_adjustments_audit until /co-approve fires. That matches design but consider also writing an 'audit_pending' row when the grant is created so all balance-affecting intents are append-only-traceable even before co-approval — not a bug, observability nit.

server.py /ads/watch L1561 — when neither with_engagement nor with_share is set, the response uses message 'Watch fully + share or engage to earn points' instead of the consistent 'No active rewarded advertisements available'. UX inconsistency but acceptable since the API contract returns awarded:false either way.

server.py L8198 admin_make_ambassador: role guard `if admin.get('role') not in ('admin', 'super_admin')` raises 403 BEFORE the require_admin_user dependency completes its own role check. require_admin_user already allows admin + super_admin per spec, so this inner check is redundant but harmless.
Test ergonomics — please re-introduce _mock_code on /auth/send-otp behind DEV_MODE=true so future iters can complete the OTP flow without manual JWT minting.

rca_of_the_issue: BUG: PUT /api/admin/feature-flags/{key} returns 403 for super_admin. ROOT CAUSE: server.py L7913-L7920 has require_admin_user as the FastAPI dependency (which correctly accepts both 'admin' and 'super_admin' roles), but then an inner check `if admin.get('role') != 'admin'` excludes super_admin. The sibling endpoints /admin/announce (L7954), /admin/dm (L8002), and /admin/users/{id}/make-ambassador (L8198) were correctly updated to `if admin.get('role') not in ('admin', 'super_admin')` but feature-flags was missed in the iter36 patch. REPRO: mint a super_admin JWT, PUT /api/admin/feature-flags/anykey with body {"value":true} → 403 {"detail":"Only admins can toggle feature flags"}. MITIGATION: one-line fix at L7919 to match the pattern used by the other three endpoints.
